name: Bliq
sub: Retrofit autonomy stack running driverless fleets under remote supervision
regions: Germany base; driverless operations in Estonia
about: Berlin company that began as a ride-hailing aggregation app for gig drivers and now develops an autonomy stack fitted to production software-defined cars, operating driverless fleets under remote supervision rather than building a purpose-built vehicle.
model: Fleet operation plus autonomy software on retrofitted production vehicles
metrics: Around a dozen driverless vehicles in operation as of May 2026, described by the company as Europe's largest fully driverless fleet.
signal: Received the first approval in an EU member state to operate on public roads with no driver behind the wheel, granted in Estonia, May 2026.

sources.title: Bliq receives Europe's first approval for fully driverless road operation without a driver behind the wheel
Tech.eu: Bliq.ai wins approval for fully driverless road operations in Estonia
